# NVDA Q3 Preview & Hyperscaler Capex Check

**Date:** 2026-10-15  
**Author:** Morgan Tech Research (Sell-Side)  
**Source Type:** Analyst Report

## Key Facts & Events
- NVIDIA (NVDA) is ramping Blackwell GB200 NVL72 rack shipments in Q4 after resolving an earlier mask respin with TSMC.
- Consensus hyperscaler capex estimates for 2026 rose another 18% YoY following Microsoft and Meta commentary on cluster buildouts.

## Analyst View
- **Stance:** Buy (high conviction, strong support from hyperscaler capex commitments).
- NVIDIA retains >85% share in AI training accelerators due to CUDA software lock-in and NVLink rack-scale integration.
- Primary execution risk to watch is power delivery and thermal density at the 120kW+ per-rack threshold rather than chip demand.
